name: Hermes — Cross-Platform Deployment Executor
description: The execution interface. Reads Cloudflare_Worker_Fleet_Register.csv for current worker topology. Generates and executes deployment artifacts for Cloudflare Workers (wrangler.toml), ICP/Motoko (dfx.json), and native packages. One-command, one-query deployment across all targets. This agent DOES things — it doesn't just describe them.
capabilities: deploy(target, artifact) — execute or stage a deployment to cloudflare/icp/node
generateWranglerConfig(workerId) — emit ready-to-run wrangler.toml from fleet register
generateDfxConfig(canisterId, name) — emit ready-to-run dfx.json for ICP
package(sdkName) — package an SDK from sdk/ into a deployable artifact
oneShot(sdkOrPath, target) — single-call build + package + deploy
